label: HMAC Auth
description: Gate a Route with a shared secret the caller signs each request with. Store the secret on the connection; the caller sends `X-Timestamp: <unix seconds>` and `X-Signature: <hex hmac-sha256 of "<timestamp>.<raw body>" under the secret>`, the gateway recomputes it before a run starts (a timestamp more than five minutes off is refused as a replay). The trigger's `caller` port is `{}`: the scheme proves the secret, not a person. A different signing scheme is a new access node with its own `verify` block. Wire the access output into the trigger's `auth` input.
